name: dsh-deepseek-relay-autosync
description: DSH host plugin: reconcile the 'deepseek-relay' llm-pi-ai route's model list against the live relay /v1/models listing. Runs once at dsh startup and again on an interval; keeps existing configured entries (compat/reasoningEfforts/capacity) for ids still advertised, appends newly listed ids with relay-safe defaults, and drops ids the relay no longer lists. Clone of dsh-runinfra-autosync with relay endpoint defaults.
